_README: Your cockpit config. Edit this file, commit, and the next build picks it up. PUBLIC ADDRESSES ONLY — never put a private key or seed phrase in this file, or in any file in this repo.

addresses._note: Hyperliquid uses EVM (0x...) addresses. Positions, PnL, funding and trade stats are all read from these. PLACEHOLDER below is a public leaderboard whale so the panels render with real data — replace with your own.
addresses._bitcoin_note: BTC taproot address held in Phantom: bc1pryefxmqhcdaxtq8mddl37gz6x9cvwjl6ugd4k2veqjdnhxlthndq602xak. Not read by any collector yet — Hyperliquid only understands 0x addresses. A future spot-balance panel could track this via a free BTC explorer API.

manualPositions._note: Positions held anywhere the APIs can't see — another venue, spot bags, TradFi. sizeUsd is the position's notional value; entry is optional and only used to show unrealised PnL when a live price is available.

items.note: Template row. Set sizeUsd to 0 or delete to hide.

cash._note: Idle balances that aren't positions, so net worth isn't understated.

risk._note: Thresholds for the risk panel. liqWarnPct: flag a position when price is within this % of its liquidation. concentrationWarnPct: flag when one asset exceeds this share of gross exposure.
